# Benefits Overview

## Health coverage

Medical, dental and vision coverage starts on the first day of employment. The company pays 90 percent of the employee premium and 70 percent of dependent premiums.

## Retirement

The company matches 401(k) contributions dollar for dollar up to 4 percent of salary. Matching contributions vest immediately.

## Learning budget

Each employee has a $1,200 annual learning budget for courses, books and conferences. Unused budget does not roll over. Conference travel is billed to the expense guide rules.

Data retention rules

Customer support tickets are kept for 3 years and then deleted. Application logs are retained for 90 days. Backups are kept for 35 days and encrypted at rest.

Financial records, including invoices and tax filings, must be retained for 7 years. Employee records are kept for 6 years after the end of employment.

Deletion requests from customers are completed within 30 days and confirmed by email.

# Expense Reimbursement Guide

Submit expenses through the finance portal within 30 days of purchase. Meals during business travel are reimbursed up to $75 per day.

## Travel

Economy airfare is the default. Flights longer than six hours may be booked in premium economy with director approval. Hotel stays are capped at $250 per night in major cities.

## Rejections

Expenses without receipts are rejected. Alcohol is never reimbursed. Appeals go to the finance operations team within 14 days.

# Meeting Norms

Every meeting needs an agenda shared at least a day in advance, or it should be cancelled. Weekly team meetings are limited to 45 minutes.

## No-meeting Wednesdays

Wednesdays are reserved for focused work. Do not schedule internal meetings on Wednesdays except for incident response.

## Notes

The organizer posts decisions and action items in the team channel within 24 hours of the meeting.

Onboarding notes for new engineers

Week one: set up your laptop, join the engineering Slack channels, and meet your onboarding buddy. Access to production is not granted until security training is complete.

Week two: ship a small starter ticket. Code review requires one approval from a teammate and passing CI. Deploys happen on weekdays before 4pm.

Support rotation: engineers join the on-call rotation after three months. The on-call engineer acknowledges pages within 15 minutes.

# Performance Review Process

Reviews happen twice a year, in June and December. Each review combines a self-assessment, peer feedback from at least three colleagues, and a manager assessment.

## Ratings

Ratings use a four-point scale: exceeds, meets, partially meets, and does not meet expectations. Promotions are decided in the December cycle only.

## Calibration

Managers meet in calibration sessions to keep ratings consistent across teams. Employees can request a written summary of their calibration outcome within 2 weeks of receiving their rating.

# Procurement and Vendor Policy

Purchases under $1,000 can be made with a company card. Purchases between $1,000 and $10,000 need written approval from a director. Anything above $10,000 requires a signed contract reviewed by legal and approval from the VP of finance.

## Vendor security

New software vendors that handle company or customer data must complete a security questionnaire before purchase. Renewals are reviewed annually.

# PTO and Leave Policy

## Vacation

Full-time employees accrue 20 days of paid time off per year, earned monthly. Up to 5 unused days may be carried over into the next calendar year. Requests of more than 5 consecutive days need manager approval at least 3 weeks ahead.

## Sick leave

Sick leave is separate from vacation and is unlimited with a doctor's note after 3 consecutive days. Tell your manager before the start of your shift when possible.

## Parental leave

Birth and adoptive parents receive 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave. Leave may be taken in one block or split into two blocks within the first 12 months.

# Remote Work Policy

Employees may work remotely up to three days per week with manager approval. Core collaboration hours are 10am to 3pm local time.

## Equipment

The company provides a laptop and a monitor. Home office stipends of $500 are available once every two years. Receipts must be submitted within 30 days.

## Security

All remote devices must use full-disk encryption and the company VPN when accessing internal systems. Lost devices must be reported to IT within 24 hours.

# Security Incident Response

## Reporting

Report suspected incidents to the security team through the #security-incidents channel or by phone at the security hotline. Do not wait to confirm: report anything that looks like phishing, leaked credentials, or unexpected access.

## Severity levels

Severity 1 incidents involve customer data exposure or production compromise and require an incident commander within 30 minutes. Severity 2 incidents are contained internal issues and are triaged within 4 hours.

## After the incident

A blameless postmortem is due within 5 business days of resolution. Postmortems are shared with the whole engineering organization.
